annotations.title: Check if a domain name is free

description: Check whether a product name is free as a domain: the name (or a domain you give) on .com, .io, .app, .dev, .ai, .co, .so and .xyz, each looked up in its registry (RDAP) — free, taken (with when it was registered, when it expires and the registrar) or no answer. A free answer means the registry has no record; confirm at a registrar before relying on it. No site is visited. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

name.description: A product name ("Acme Notes") or a domain ("acme.dev") to try first.

name: check_domain_availability

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.
